entries.t: <FACE:71>Ugh, it's freeeezing!<NL><WAIT>Why me, the Summer<NL>Tropical Queen?!
<FACE:7D>Can't be helped-robo<NL>Even if it's frozen<WAIT><FACE:7D>It's a river, so Boss<NL>Sekiran's job-robo…
<FACE:71>That's it! I'm going<NL>home!
<FACE:81>Ah! Boss Sekiraaan!<NL>Come baaack-robooo!!!
<FACE:80>No good-robo!!<NL><WAIT>Boss Sekiran ran off,<NL>the ice is cracking!
<FACE:71>Out of my way! Move!<WAIT><FACE:03>Ah!
<FACE:05>What was that?
<FACE:03>Never mind that, look!<NL><WAIT><FACE:00>The control device is<NL>across the ice!
<FACE:80>No-robo!<NL><WAIT>Come over and the ice<NL>breaks, no way back!
<FACE:04>What do we do…<NL>
<FACE:04>We can't secure this<NL>Block from this side…
<FACE:09>True, if we all go<NL>the ice might break…<WAIT><FACE:07>One alone would be<NL>fine, right, <PLAYER>?
<FACE:04>Not this again!<NL><WAIT>What if something<NL>happens to him?!
<FACE:07>It'll be fine!<WAIT><FACE:05>The view's clear, so<NL>if a Robattle starts<WAIT>I can join in from<NL>right here!
<FACE:04>That's not the point…
<FACE:07>Just go, go on!
<FACE:06>That's the wrong way!<NL>Hurry up and go!
<FACE:05>Good luck, <PLAYER>!
<FACE:0A>Moving around so much<NL>can't be a good idea
<FACE:19>That was Sekiran just<NL>now, wasn't it
<FACE:14>Fall in and you won't<NL>be coming back
